$comment: A grounded verdict. decision=PASS or a claim being confirmed must cite grounded_in (real, non-inference claim ids that resolve in claims.json). decision=REVISE/FAIL must name required_evidence.

grounded_in.description: Claim ids from claims.json that support a PASS. Required when decision is PASS and the claim being reviewed makes a factual assertion.

required_evidence.description: What's missing. Required when decision is REVISE or FAIL.
